data.body_html:
July 2039 in Marbella means 30°C heat, 24°C sea, and 14-knot breezes — ideal conditions for a boat charter. Whether you're planning a family day out or a party with friends, this guide covers everything from weather patterns to booking tips. Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús and Marbella Marina, with options for every group size and budget.

Marbella Boat Rental Weather July 2039: What to Expect

July in Marbella is characterised by high pressure, clear skies, and minimal rainfall. Average daytime temperatures hit 30°C, with peaks around 34°C in the afternoon. The sea temperature rises to a pleasant 24°C, making swimming and snorkelling comfortable. The Levante wind (easterly) averages 14 knots, picking up in the afternoon — calm mornings are best for smooth cruising. Humidity is low (around 50%), so the heat feels manageable, especially on the water with a sea breeze.

Top Boats for July Heat

For hot days, choose boats with shaded areas or air conditioning. Our Marbella boat rental fleet includes several ideal options:

  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) — flybridge shade, €2,299/8h (Tier B pricing).
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) — spacious cockpit, includes jet ski, €4,719/4h.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) — air-conditioned saloon, perfect for escaping midday sun.
  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) — affordable option at €749/2h, with bimini top.

All charters include unlimited drinks and snacks to keep you refreshed.

Best Itineraries for July

Depart from Puerto Banús and head east towards Cabopino or west to Estepona. Cala del Faro offers a protected cove for swimming, while Cala Cortés is quieter. For a longer trip, Sotogrande is 25 NM west, about 1.5 hours at cruising speed. Sunset cruises along the Golden Mile are popular — the light on La Concha mountain is stunning at 21:00.

Booking Advice for July 2039

July is peak season. Book 4-6 weeks in advance to secure your preferred boat. Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749/2h, while the Mangusta 80 requires a minimum 4-hour booking at €4,719 (includes jet ski). For other boats like the Pershing 46 or Canados 86, pricing is on request via WhatsApp. All prices include skipper, fuel, insurance, and IVA.

What’s Included in Your Charter

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%). No hidden extras. The skipper will navigate to calm spots and can suggest anchorages based on wind conditions. You just bring sunscreen and a towel.

Safety in July Heat

We provide plenty of fresh water and shaded areas on all boats. Life jackets are available for all ages. The skipper monitors weather forecasts and will adjust the route if afternoon winds pick up. July storms are rare but possible — we offer free rescheduling if needed.

Frequently asked questions

What is the typical weather in Marbella in July 2039?

Expect clear skies, average 30°C, with highs of 34°C. Sea temperature reaches 24°C, perfect for swimming. Afternoon breezes from the Levante wind keep things comfortable, typically 14 knots.

Do I need to book a boat rental in advance for July 2039?

Yes, July is peak season. We recommend booking 4-6 weeks ahead to secure your preferred boat. Popular models like the Azimut 58 Flybridge and Mangusta 80 often sell out early.

What is included in the charter price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees.

Which boats are best for hot July days?

Boats with flybridges, like the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) or the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax), offer shaded upper decks and good airflow. The Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) has air-conditioned interiors.

Can I swim and snorkel during the charter?

Absolutely. July sea temperatures of 24°C are ideal. Popular anchorages include Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés. Your skipper will choose calm spots, and snorkelling gear is provided on request.

What time of day is best for a July boat trip?

Morning departures (10:00-12:00) offer calm seas and cooler temperatures. Sunset cruises (18:00-21:00) are also popular, with temperatures dropping to 22°C. Midday heat is manageable with shade and onboard drinks.

Are there any restrictions for children on board?

No age restrictions. Life jackets are available for all sizes. Our boats like the Lagoon 380 (11.6m, 10 pax) are family-friendly. Just inform us of any specific needs when booking.

What happens if the weather is bad in July 2039?

July is statistically the sunniest month, but if a storm is forecast, we offer free rescheduling or a full refund. Your skipper will monitor conditions and adjust the route for safety.
